tool_config.name: prepare_pay
tool_config.description: Prepare a payment to one of her saved payees. Pass the payee exactly as she said it, in Tamil or English (for example "poo kadai", "flower shop", "medical kadai"). If the result has options, ask her which one she means. Never ask for UPI details. Nothing moves until she taps Yes or types her PIN on her screen.

payee.description: Who she wants to pay, in her own words.

amount.description: Amount in rupees, a whole number she said. Never guess.
